title: Dr. Herbert West

[[Image:DrHerbertWest.png|thumb]]
'''Dr. Herbert West''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Congregational Hospital]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Speed]]
*+1 [[Will]]

[[Upkeep]]: Pay 1 [[Focus]] and exhaust to gain 1 [[Stamina]].

== Errata ==
Discard Dr. Herbert West if the [[Ancient One]] awakens.

==Mythos Source==
Herbert West is the inventor of a reagent that can reanimate the dead, and he appears in H.P. Lovecraft's short story ''Herbert West -- Reanimator'' (1921).
